scenarios.note: Pinned page: every chart is a ChartContainer of 320x200 px (className aspect-auto h-[200px] w-[320px], initialDimension 320x200, so the measured container equals the initial one), animation off, series data fixed. Hover rule: a hover step targets .recharts-wrapper with position {x, y} relative to its top-left; x is the centre of the category band, left + (i + 0.5) * plotWidth / n, where left = margin.left (5) + the widths of the y axes and plotWidth = 320 - 5 - 5 - those widths (310 / 6 = 51.667 px per month, no y axis: x(0) = 30.83, x(2) = 134.17, x(4) = 237.5); y = 60, inside the plot. A point scale (line, area: margin {left: 12, right: 12}) puts category i at 12 + i * 296 / (n - 1). The coordinates are derived from the data, never measured.

JSON config cannot carry an icon component, so hideIcon renders the swatch exactly like legend__bottom; this keeps the no-icon path under G2, the icon path is covered by test/chadcn/chart_test.rb (item #45).

Resize (item #107): one bar chart laid out at 320x200, 480x300 and 640x400 (same id resize-bar). G2 proves the server render at each size against recharts; test/javascript/chart_resize.test.mjs answers the re-layout request of the 320 chart with the Phlex page of the 480 and 640 scenarios and compares the swapped chart with recharts resized in the browser.
pointer over a radar: the angle category under it, the polar cursor and the active dots; outside the radius clears it
keyboard on a radar: focus, arrows, a hover in between and Escape
trigger click on a radar: a hover shows nothing, a click shows the category and leaving keeps it
pointer over an axis radial bar chart: the ring under it and the arc cursor; the hole clears it
keyboard on a radial bar chart: focus, arrow, Enter toggles, Escape
pointer over a pie: the sector under it, placed at its tooltip position; off the pie hides it
keyboard on a pie: focus, arrows, a hover in between and Escape
trigger click on a pie: only a click on a sector shows it, leaving keeps it
